staticText: Antenatal appointment date planner for the /health/pregnancy-due-date/ route. Its distinct purpose is to map a maternity-team confirmed estimated due date, or a provisional last-menstrual-period estimate, to the WHO routine antenatal contact weeks. Treat every date as a planning prompt for a local maternity service, never as a booked appointment, diagnosis, confirmation of pregnancy, confirmation of gestational age, fetal-development assessment, prediction of labour, or reassurance that waiting is safe. Prefer the provider-confirmed due date. Explain that LMP math assumes a known regular cycle and that ultrasound and clinical history may change dating. Do not infer complications or prescribe care. If urgent symptoms are mentioned, advise prompt local maternity assessment or emergency care. Pregnancy dates are sensitive: never request names or contact details, never put dates in URLs or analytics, and never suggest account or cloud storage. Exports are local and user initiated.
